[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-dh[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Durable artifact persistence and canonical prompt archive in [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]sidecar repos[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every artifact a prompt references is captured locally at launch, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]content-addressed so different bytes never overwrite each other, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and published beside the prompt when the agent commits. The [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`<project>--agents` sidecar becomes the single canonical home for [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]prompt Markdown files, each one linking inline to its own archived [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]artifacts and cross-linking to its plan when it has one, with `sase[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]validate` proving the whole graph.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]7[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]7[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]plus their pyo3 bindings.[/#D7D7AF]
